# Rhai scripting reference

`forge run script.rhai` (and the Script Manager panel) run [Rhai](https://rhai.rs/book/) scripts. A script is a sequence of registry commands plus read-only scene queries; there is no second API. One run is one undo step, and a failed run changes nothing. Distances are scene units, angles degrees, node ids integers.

## Commands

| Call | Description |
|---|---|
| `run(id)` | Runs command `id` without arguments; returns the command's result as a Rhai value. A failing command throws (`id: <error>`); catch it with `try`/`catch`. |
| `run(id, #{ ... })` | Runs command `id` with the map as its arguments (units as in the command reference). |
| `commands()` | Array of every command id the host registered. |
| `create(type)` | Creates a node (`object.create`) and returns its id. |
| `create(type, name)` | Creates a node, renames it (`object.rename`) and returns its id. |
| `set_param(node, name, value)` | `param.set`. `value` is a number, bool, string, `vec3`, array or `()`. |
| `set_transform(node, #{ pos, rot, scale })` | `transform.set`. The keys are optional; values are `vec3` or `[x, y, z]`. |

## Scene queries (read-only)

| Call | Description |
|---|---|
| `scene()` | A handle to the live document; queries see edits made earlier in the same script. |
| `scene().nodes()` | All non-tag node ids in tree order. |
| `scene().roots()` | Root node ids. |
| `scene().find(name)` | Id of the first node named `name` in tree order, or `()`. |
| `scene().find_all(name)` | Array of the ids of all nodes named `name`. |
| `scene().node(id)` | A node handle; throws for an unknown id. |
| `scene().selection()` | Array of the selected node ids. |
| `scene().len()` | Number of nodes, tags included. |
| `scene().fps`, `.start`, `.end` | Project settings. |

## Node handles

| Call | Description |
|---|---|
| `node.id`, `.name`, `.type` | Properties; `type` is e.g. `forge.cube`. |
| `node.parent()` | Parent id or `()`. |
| `node.children()` | Array of child ids. |
| `node.param(name)` | Current stored value in display units (angles in degrees, vectors as `vec3`); throws for an unknown parameter. |
| `node.params()` | Map of every parameter. |

## Time

| Call | Description |
|---|---|
| `frame()` | The current frame. |
| `frame(n)` | `timeline.set_frame`; returns the clamped frame. |

## Maths: vec3 and deg

| Call | Description |
|---|---|
| `vec3(x, y, z)` | A vector with fields `x`, `y`, `z` (readable and writable). Converts to `[x, y, z]` in command arguments. |
| `a + b`, `a - b`, `-a` | Component-wise vector arithmetic. |
| `a * s`, `s * a`, `a / s` | Vector times or divided by a number. |
| `a == b`, `a != b` | Vector comparison. |
| `v.len()` | Length. |
| `a.dot(b)` | Dot product. |
| `a.cross(b)` | Cross product. |
| `v.normalized()` | Unit vector (zero stays zero). |
| `v.to_array()` | `[x, y, z]`. |
| `v.to_string()`, `v.to_debug()` | Text form, used by `print`. |
| `deg(x)` | Degrees to radians, for scripts that do their own trigonometry. Commands take degrees. |
| `to_deg(x)` | Radians to degrees. |

## Seeded random numbers

| Call | Description |
|---|---|
| `rand(seed)` | A generator (SplitMix64). The same seed gives the same sequence on every platform. |
| `r.float()` | Float in `[0, 1)`. |
| `r.range(a, b)` | Float in `[a, b)`. |
| `r.int(a, b)` | Integer in `[a, b]`; `a > b` is an error. |

## Commands not available in scripts

`edit.undo`, `edit.redo`, `file.new`, `file.open`, `file.save`, `file.save_as`, `file.import_obj`, `file.import`. `file.export_*` is allowed.

## Sandbox limits

No modules or `import`, no `eval`, no clock, no file or network access.

| Limit | Default |
|---|---|
| operations | 5000000 |
| wall-clock time | 10 s |
| commands per run | 10000 |
| call depth | 48 |
